Definition: from G1894 and G4007; since indeed (of cause):--forasmuch.
BiblicalUsage: Epeideper means forasmuch, since indeed — Luke's opening word for why he wrote at all. Forasmuch as many have taken in hand to set forth the things most surely believed among us, he will write them in order, that Theophilus may know the certainty.
TheologicalSignificance: Luke's careful opening is a gift, I hold: the gospel was investigated, ordered, and written down so faith could rest on certainty, not rumour.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
